name: Voyage AI
billing: Embeddings are billed by the selected model and input tokens, subject to your current allowance and plan. The local example embeds only “Hello.”; review the dashboard’s billing and limits first.

steps.title: Sign in to the Voyage dashboard
steps.body: Create or sign in to your Voyage AI account and open the API keys section linked in the official guide.

steps.title: Create an application secret key
steps.body: Choose Create new secret key and store it privately in your application’s environment. Use Prism’s environment name below, which can differ from the provider’s standalone SDK.

steps.title: Check embedding model access
steps.body: Choose a text embedding model your account can use, then review current usage limits and payment settings. This provider supplies embeddings rather than text completions.
